question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place
The object extends from Śiva down to Avīci
inference: One should meditate on that reality as pervading every level from Śiva to Avīci
plain_english: Having meditated on him in every place, one should contemplate him as extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
